source.notes: ICSE Class IX school annual examination paper (school not named). Header prints 'Annual Examination [2024-2025]', 'CLASS: IX', 'SUBJECT: PHYSICS (PAPER 1)', 'TIME: 2 HOURS', 'MM: 80'; examYear 2025 is the later year of the printed session (also the year in the file name). Section A (40 marks, compulsory): Question 1 prints [1×15 = 15], so each of the fifteen MCQs is a 1-mark entry; Questions 2 and 3 print marks per part. Section B: attempt any four of Questions 4-9 (10 marks each, printed per part), so the pack's marks total exceeds 80. Composite brackets such as [1+1=2] are recorded as their printed totals. The scan is faint and skewed in places; option (d) of Q1 x. is illegible. The PDF has no text layer (watermark only); text was OCRed with RapidOCR and corrected against the page images. Handwritten ticks are ignored. Figures are not reproduced. No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
